I have an urgent assignment for you. You are not yet aware of the situation, so I will need to provide some context. However, everything I am about to disclose is top secret, understood? There is a secured facility within the blockade perimeter that is of interest to my contacts in the nuclear energy sector. The issue is that it is an icebreaker ship, currently stranded in the bay. To access it, you will need to acquire suitable transport, and it is preferable to do so quietly. No one must know that the vessel is present in Tarkov's waters at all! Once you secure transport, you are to retrieve operational documentation from the ship. Search the engineering sections, there should be a logbook for the nuclear power unit control system. Do not, under any circumstances, disclose this task to anyone.}} ==Objectives== * Locate and obtain the [[Nuclear power unit control log|nuclear power unit control log]] on [[Icebreaker]] * Hand over the found [[Nuclear power unit control log|item]] ==Rewards== * +24,000 [[EXP]] * 3,600 Dollars ** 3,780 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 4,140 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[HK G28 7.62x51 marksman rifle]] * 5× [[7.62x51mm M80A1 ammo pack (20 pcs)]] * 3× [[HK417/G28 7.62x51 20-round magazine]] {{quote|You have the logbook? I trust you avoided drawing attention on your way back. I will arrange your reward through my associates. One more thing: I strongly advise against returning to the Icebreaker.
